project.name: Bollington Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 10 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 25 of 44 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Bollington qualifies as a local detour through Bollington Discovery Centre and Bollington Arts Centre. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Bollington: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Bollington offers Bollington Discovery Centre, Bollington Arts Centre, Canal bridge number 27 within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Bollington Discovery Centre
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Bollington Discovery Centre and Bollington Arts Centre, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
